run_solver_affine_transform: run the affine transform solver on a 2D image with a given transformation matrix
solve_affine_transform_2d: solve a 2D affine transformation problem by applying a matrix to an input image
initialize_affine_transform_solver: initialize the AffineTransform2D solver with nearest-neighbor interpolation order and constant boundary mode
validate_affine_transform_solution: validate a proposed affine transform solution against a reference scipy output
refactor_interpolation_order: refactor the AffineTransform2D class to use linear or cubic interpolation instead of nearest-neighbor
